title: Concept: Release build keeps code shrinking disabled in gradle — review required
description: In gradle, the release pipeline is configured without code shrinking. Decompilation of a non-minified APK recovers near-original structure, which shortens the path from a published binary to a working exploit. Shrinking is not a security boundary by itself, but removing it is a deliberate hardening regression.
risk: Easier reverse engineering and code tampering; MEDIUM severity.
